collection.description: A seventeen-year-old is interested in another villager aged 14-17 and worries about saying anything.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (teen), a seventeen-year-old, is interested in (other) and worries about saying anything.

choices.label: Ask a Trusted Peer for Advice

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (other) returns the feeling and suggests getting to know each other.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (other) declines gently, and the friendship remains respectful.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (peer) encourages patience rather than making assumptions.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The two enjoy working side by side and become closer.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The activity is pleasant but does not lead to romance.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (teen) decides later that the crush has faded.
